identity.name: Seamaster Diver 300M
identity.one_liner: The 2018 ground-up redesign of Omega's 300M diver for its 25th anniversary — a larger case, ceramic wave-pattern dial, sapphire caseback, and the Master Chronometer caliber 8800.

narrative.story: The Seamaster Diver 300M has carried Omega's James Bond association since GoldenEye in 1995, but this exact reference is not that watch. The 210.30 case grew to 42mm at the 2018 relaunch, when Omega replaced the older case entirely with a laser-engraved wave-pattern ceramic dial, a ceramic bezel insert, a sapphire caseback, and the silicon-hairspring Master Chronometer caliber 8800. Bond-specific executions run on a separate titanium reference with a different dial color and caseback engraving.
narrative.collector_notes: This reference is the black-dial, black-bezel, steel-bracelet configuration — confirm the last digits of the reference against listing photos, since Omega sells the same 210.30 base case across several dial colors and strap options, and don't confuse it with the 210.22 titanium 007 edition.
